WITH t AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m USING(member_key) WHERE e.campaign_id=15),
h AS (SELECT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15),
cur AS (SELECT member_id, MIN(join_date) jd, BOOL_OR(marketing_consent) any_consent FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1)
SELECT g, COUNT(*) n, SUM((jd > DATE '2025-11-24')::INT) joined_after_start, SUM((jd > DATE '2025-12-07')::INT) joined_after_end, SUM((NOT any_consent)::INT) never_consent

SELECT s.store_id = 900 AS is_web, w.status, w.web_order_id IS NULL AS no_order_row,
  COUNT(*) lines, SUM(f.net_amount) net,
  SUM((f.member_key IS NOT NULL)::INT) member_lines,
  SUM((CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', w.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-12-07')::INT) dispatch_in_window,
  SUM((f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-24' AND DATE '2025-12-07')::INT) saledate_in_window
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id AND s.store_id=900
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-17' AND DATE '2025-12-21'
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

calls.statement:
WITH campaign AS (
    SELECT campaign_id, campaign_name, start_date, end_date + 7 AS window_end
    FROM dim_campaign WHERE campaign_id = 15
),
targeted AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
    FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key
    WHERE e.campaign_id = 15
),
holdout AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id = 15),
members AS (
    SELECT member_id, 'targeted' AS member_group FROM targeted
    UNION ALL SELECT member_id, 'holdout' FROM holdout
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
member_sales AS (
    SELECT m.member_id, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_member m  ON m.member_key = f.member_key
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    CROSS JOIN campaign c
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN w.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END BETWEEN c.start_date AND c.window_end
    GROUP BY 1
),
by_group AS (
    SELECT mb.member_group, COUNT(*) AS members, SUM((ms.member_id IS NOT NULL)::INT) AS buyers,
           AVG(COALESCE(ms.net_sales, 0)) AS mean_net_sales
    FROM members mb LEFT JOIN member_sales ms ON ms.member_id = mb.member_id
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT member_group, members, buyers, ROUND(mean_net_sales, 4) AS mean FROM by_group
UNION ALL
SELECT 'uplift', NULL, NULL, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN member_group='targeted' THEN mean_net_sales END) - MAX(CASE WHEN member_group='holdout' THEN mean_net_sales END), 4) FROM by_group

UNION ALL SELECT 'holdout w/ exposure by member_id', COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m USING(member_key) WHERE campaign_id=15) t JOIN campaign_holdout h ON h.member_id=t.member_id AND h.campaign_id=15
UNION ALL SELECT 'bak campaign15 holdout_size', holdout_size FROM bak_dim_campaign_2025 WHERE campaign_id=15
UNION ALL SELECT 'bak campaign15 mailing', mailing_list_size FROM bak_dim_campaign_2025 WHERE campaign_id=15
